content.short: Sublime Ethereum is a code editor for building with EVM-compatible languages.
content.description: Sublime Ethereum is a code editor designed for building within the Ethereum ecosystem. It supports Cairo, Yul, Vyper, and Solidity, providing an inclusive environment for developers working on Ethereum and its scaling solutions. As an open-source project, the initiative invites developers to contribute changes that improve the IDE, address issues, and broaden compatibility across networks and development workflows. This collaborative approach aims to continually evolve the tool to meet the needs of Web3 developers.
